fields.Name: Request Project Risk Review
fields.Description: Triggers an on-demand Project Risk Analyst evaluation running as the project owner user (consuming subtask velocity, blocked dependencies, check-ins, overdue items, ML breach probability, and sanitized calendar free/busy windows with zero event subject or body exposure), persists a Task Risk Assessments row, and synchronizes HealthStatus, ConfidenceScore, and ForecastCompletionDate onto the root project task.
fields.UserPrompt: Run an on-demand AI project risk review and forecast update for a project task.

fields.Name: TaskID
fields.Description: UUID of the project root task (or descendant subtask, resolved to the root project task).

fields.Name: Force
fields.Description: When true (default), runs immediately regardless of cadence cooldown; when false, respects Weekly/Daily cadence cooldown.

fields.Name: MLBreachProbability
fields.Description: Optional ML SLA breach probability override in [0, 1].

fields.Name: MLBreachRiskBand
fields.Description: Optional ML SLA risk band override (Low, Medium, High, Critical).

fields.Name: FreeBusyJSON
fields.Description: Optional JSON array of assignee calendar free/busy slot overrides (strictly sanitized to remove any subject/body/title/attendee metadata).

fields.Name: Skipped
fields.Description: True when Force=false and the review was skipped within the active cadence cooldown window.

fields.Name: SkipReason
fields.Description: Explanation when the review was skipped due to cadence cooldown or terminal task status.

fields.Name: OwnerUserID
fields.Description: UUID of the project owner User under whose context the review ran.

fields.Name: AssessedAt
fields.Description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the assessment was recorded.

fields.Name: AssessmentID
fields.Description: UUID of the newly persisted Task Risk Assessments record.

fields.Name: HealthStatus
fields.Description: Assessed project health status (OnTrack, AtRisk, OffTrack, Completed, Paused).

fields.Name: ForecastCompletionDate
fields.Description: ISO-8601 forecasted project completion date.

fields.Name: ForecastConfidence
fields.Description: Forecast confidence percentage (0-100).

fields.Name: MLBreachProbabilityOutput

fields.Name: Risks
fields.Description: JSON array of typed risk objects (kind, severity, evidenceLinks, suggestedMitigation).

fields.Name: AgentRunID
fields.Description: UUID of the MJ: AI Agent Runs record created for this risk review.

fields.Name: PromptTokens
fields.Description: Prompt token count consumed by the risk review agent run.

fields.Name: CompletionTokens

fields.Name: TotalCostUSD
fields.Description: Total AI execution cost in USD for the risk review agent run.
